# LeadStrategus

> LeadStrategus (leadstrategus.ai) is an AI agent platform for B2B revenue teams, based in Bengaluru, India. Its AI agents detect real-market buying signals, identify and prioritise high-intent accounts, write signal-based outreach, and help book meetings, from account discovery through to revenue. Each deployment is run with an operator team that maintains the system weekly.

LeadStrategus differs from US-built sales tools by covering Indian market signals (Naukri and Monster hiring data; GeM, CPPP, state-portal and PSU tenders) alongside LinkedIn, news, and annual-report signals.

## Services

- AI agents across seven B2B funnel stages: Account Discovery, Buying Intent, Account Prioritization, Messaging & Outreach, Monitoring & Reactivation, Meeting Conversion, and Data & Ops.
- Live agents include LinkedIn and Naukri job scrapers (hiring-intent signals), lead-generation scrapers, and a LinkedIn message generator; more are rolling out.
- Custom AI agents built for a company's own GTM workflow.
- Operator-run pipeline: setup in 2–3 weeks, maintained weekly by the LeadStrategus team.
